facts: One of Shakespeare’s most mischievous characters is Crab, the dog belonging to Launce in the Two Gentlemen of Verona. The word "watchdog" is first found in The Tempest.
Dogs who have been spayed or neutered live longer than intact dogs.
A dog's sense of smell is 10,000 times stronger than a human's.
The most intelligent breed of dog is the Border Collie.
A dog's sense of smell is so powerful that they can detect changes in a person's emotional state.
